newsitem.title: FRANCE: USAir to fund most of Airbus orders.
newsitem.headline: USAir to fund most of Airbus orders.

text.p: A bumper order for 120 planes in the Airbus Industrie A320 family by USAir, announced earlier, will be mostly financed by the Pittsburgh-based airline, an industry source said on Wednesday.
"USAir is financing almost all of it, with Airbus participating," said the source who declined to be identified. The source declined to give further details.
No decision has yet been taken on engines for the planes, which are offered with the V2500 motors from the International Aeroengines consortium and the CFM-56 from CFM International.
USAir earlier said it agreed to buy 120 Airbus single-aisle A319, A320 and A321 planes, with options for up to 280 more.
CFM International is a joint venture between U.S. group General Electric Co and France's state-owend Snecma.
International Aeroengines is a five-firm joint venture led by Britain's Rolls Royce and Pratt and Whitney of U.S. United Technologies Corp.

Airbus Industrie is a consortium made up of French state-owned Ste Nationale Industrielle Aerospatiale, British Aerospace Plc, Daimler-Benz Aerospace, a unit of Daimler-Benz AG and Construcciones Aeronauticas SA (CASA) of Spain.
